reviews.text: Shocking customer care rang twice for directions as not from area no help then rang me.to cancel my appointment
What a wonderful experience again today that Bailey had with Declan and his staff, getting her grooming done. She looks stunning

A pleasure to deal with - clearly puts the dog's wellbeing above all else. Our dog was way more relaxed and happy after his groom than he has been with anyone else and got a great trim that suits him and the current weather. The super reasonable price and quick turnaround time has definitely made us repeat customers :)
Very kind and professional myles loves going there
Absolutely amazing my fur baby loves going here

Just collected our 5 month old cavapoo from her first full groom with Declan & the gang. I'm absolutely delighted with the result. They concentrated on all the important places - the face, bottom, paws etc... - but still left plenty of fluff on Honey so she still looks completely like herself, just ALOT neater!!! Declan and his team are so brilliant with the dogs and I trust them 100% to look after our little furbaby. So much so, I have already booked her in for her next appointment. Highly recommend 🥰

Declan is lovely, chatty and great with the dogs. I love the pictures on FB throughout the day, my puppy had so much fun, he slept the minute we got home for the whole night. I love that the dogs are not just thrown out in the rain in a field. I have re booked already, definitely recommend 👌  spot my guy in the photo 😍 …
Had our Newfoundland groomed and they were fantastic. She looked so gorgeous honestly. Very happy and extremely reasonably priced.
Declan is the nicest man ever absolutely unbelievable at his job. Wouldn’t pass my golden retriever to anyone else. Most genuine man I’ve ever come across 10/10 recommend

Declan and his team have a great way with dogs. They groomed my dog to perfection, even though he normally resist grooming. I also use their daycare service. They go above and beyond to look after the dogs in their care.

So glad to have found someone I felt at ease with my dogs.
Declan is clearly a very caring and knowledgeable groomer.
Very happy with the results. The consultation was worthwhile, Declan knows his craft. Happy customers all around.

I had tried lots of groomers b4 i heard about declans my dog runs the road when i say wer going to declans day care and i love when they groom her staff are so friendly i know my callie is in the best care with them
Declan is an excellent groomer; my dogs love him. I highly recommend this place.
Great experience all round, have been admiring my dog Linus since, super cute cut :)

Our puppy goes to this daycare a bit longer than a month ago and he ADORES it.
He pulls us in the morning as soon as he gets the scent.
The staff is AMAZING.
We considered this place for our puppy so he could socialise and also so we could go to work without feeling guilty of leaving him alone.
I couldn't recommend this place more.
Highly recommend, my 2 dogs love going to school every morning!! Declan and the crew are fantastic 😍 …
Our dog loves going to Cheeky Pups. Staff are very friendly and understanding of every dog.
